{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the U-shaped profile
# Total width: 70mm, height: 40mm, web thickness: 5mm
# The U-shape will consist of three parts: two flanges and one web

# Flange dimensions (top and bottom)
flange_width = 70  # mm
flange_height = 5   # mm (web thickness)

# Web dimensions
web_width = 5       # mm (web thickness)
web_height = 40 - 2 * flange_height  # mm (total height minus two flanges)

# Length of the profile
profile_length = 450  # mm

# Positions for the flanges and web
# Flange 1 (bottom)
flange1_x = 0
flange1_y = 0
flange1_z = 0

# Web
web_x = 0
web_y = flange_height
web_z = 0

# Flange 2 (top)
flange2_x = 0
flange2_y = flange_height + web_height
flange2_z = 0

# Return the calculated values
{
    "flange_width": flange_width,
    "flange_height": flange_height,
    "web_width": web_width,
    "web_height": web_height,
    "profile_length": profile_length,
    "flange1_x": flange1_x,
    "flange1_y": flange1_y,
    "flange1_z": flange1_z,
    "web_x": web_x,
    "web_y": web_y,
    "web_z": web_z,
    "flange2_x": flange2_x,
    "flange2_y": flange2_y,
    "flange2_z": flange2_z
}"}
